publication: Historical tactical task, outside the prematch football score metric
data: StatsBomb Open Data, UEFA Euro 2024, competition 55, season 282
task: Identify the receiver conditional on a successfully completed regular-play pass in the first half, given passer and origin. Use the starting XI until the first personnel change in the passing team. Predict among the other ten players.
training: All group-stage fixtures; order by kickoff. UEFA Euro 2024 knockout fixtures are the sole holdout. Freeze the split and recipe before measuring holdout results.
treatments: shared pair scorer using direct dyad, prior node totals, positions and locations
same scorer additionally using one directed message-passing layer over the passing graph as it existed before the current pass
training_recipe: Twelve hidden units with tanh, categorical cross entropy, Adam learning rate 0.003, 16 epochs, batch 128, weight decay 0.0001, seed 20261118. Fixed for both trained arms.
metrics: coverage vs all complete first-half regular-play passes
paired 95% interval clustered by held-out match
